notes: soundLAB 2.1: three new things that fit right into the pages you already use. Exercises now shows your weak spots and gives you more of the notes you miss. A MIDI guitar (like the Rock Band 3 Squier) is found with one strum and shows string and fret on the neck. And Train > Voice lets you sing and see your pitch, with key lights and Practice Plan sing blocks. Your progress and settings carry over.
